questions.stemEn: A child with Down syndrome has WBC about 100,000/µL with 60% blasts. Which management is most appropriate among the recalled choices?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يربط hyperleukocytosis في transient abnormal myelopoiesis لدى Down syndrome بخطر أعلى ويختار low-dose cytarabine. العمر وبقية high-risk features غير مذكورة بوضوح في recall، لذلك يلزم التحقق.
questions.clinicalPearl: Management of TAM depends on age and high-risk clinical features, not blast count alone.

questions.stemEn: A 4-year-old has café-au-lait spots, a bifid thumb, and pancytopenia. Which hematologic condition is the child at greatest risk of developing?
questions.explanationAr: الملف يرجّح Myelodysplastic syndrome لكنه يذكر AML كاحتمال أيضًا ضمن malignant myeloid transformation في Fanconi anemia؛ لذلك يبقى السؤال للمراجعة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Fanconi anemia confers a major risk of clonal marrow disease including MDS and AML.

sourceRefs.notes: Source says D most likely, or B.

questions.stemEn: A child has dysmorphic features shown in an image and pancytopenia. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار Fanconi anemia، لكن السؤال يعتمد على dysmorphic image ويجب إرفاق الصورة قبل النشر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Fanconi anemia is a marrow-failure syndrome with characteristic congenital anomalies; Fanconi syndrome is a renal tubular disorder.

questions.stemEn: A child with pallor has an image showing marked gingival hyperplasia. Which malignancy is most strongly associated with this finding?
questions.explanationAr: gingival infiltration/hyperplasia تُذكر في التجميع كـ clue لـ myeloid leukemia، خصوصًا AML. الصورة الأصلية مطلوبة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Gingival hypertrophy is a classic board clue for certain AML subtypes.

questions.stemEn: A 6-year-old has migratory arthritis, rash, nocturnal pain, fever for two months, poor response to aspirin, and pancytopenia. What is the next diagnostic step?
questions.explanationAr: وجود prolonged bone/joint symptoms مع fever وpancytopenia يجعل leukemia diagnosis مهمًا للاستبعاد، ولذلك التجميع يختار bone marrow aspiration.
questions.clinicalPearl: Persistent musculoskeletal symptoms plus cytopenias should prompt evaluation for leukemia before labeling a rheumatologic disorder.

questions.stemEn: A 3-year-old with leukemia features has very high blast burden. Which initial measure is appropriate to reduce tumor lysis risk among the recalled choices?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار aggressive hydration + allopurinol، لكنه يذكر في الشرح أن high-risk TLS قد يُفضّل فيه rasburicase؛ لذا الإجابة تعتمد على درجة الخطورة والتفاصيل الناقصة.
questions.clinicalPearl: TLS prophylaxis is risk-stratified; hydration is foundational, while urate-lowering choice depends on risk and uric acid level.

questions.stemEn: A child post-transplant develops severe diarrhea and stool studies consistent with C. difficile while receiving cefepime and vancomycin for febrile neutropenia; cultures are negative. What is the best plan among the recalled choices?
questions.explanationAr: الملف يؤكد أهمية إيقاف inciting antibiotics عند الإمكان، لكنه أيضًا يذكر أن febrile neutropenia قد يفرض استمرار antimicrobial coverage إذا كانت هناك حاجة سريرية. لذلك لا ننشر A كقاعدة مطلقة دون التحقق من السياق.
questions.clinicalPearl: C. difficile management in an immunocompromised child must balance stopping unnecessary antibiotics against ongoing neutropenic-infection risk.

tts.text: A child post-transplant develops C. difficile diarrhea while receiving broad-spectrum antibiotics for febrile neutropenia and cultures are negative. What is the best plan?

sourceRefs.notes: Also recalled in 2017; source emphasizes stopping inciting antibiotics when possible.

questions.stemEn: An adolescent with ALL develops progressive respiratory symptoms two weeks after induction, with anemia, thrombocytopenia and leukopenia. Which treatment was recalled as the best option?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع نفسه يقول إن التشخيص غير واضح ويقترح TMA/aHUS كاحتمال، ثم يختار eculizumab. لا توجد معطيات كافية في الـrecall لتثبيت التشخيص أو العلاج.
questions.clinicalPearl: Do not publish treatment when the recalled diagnosis is uncertain; recover the original question or verify against primary context.

questions.stemEn: A child with fever has a histology image showing findings recalled as Hodgkin lymphoma. Which infectious association is most likely?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يربط Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin lymphoma في الصورة بـ EBV association، مع اختلاف النسبة حسب subtype والجغرافيا. الصورة الأصلية مطلوبة.
questions.clinicalPearl: EBV association varies across Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes and populations.

questions.stemEn: A child has a persistent, nontender cervical lymph node about 2.5 cm that does not improve after antibiotics. What is the best next step?
questions.explanationAr: persistent lymph node >2 cm وعدم الاستجابة للمضاد يرفع القلق من malignancy؛ التجميع يختار excisional biopsy لأنه يحافظ على nodal architecture.
questions.clinicalPearl: When malignancy is a concern, excisional biopsy is often preferred because architecture is preserved.
